theme: Skia m151 with span-based perf work
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed code.
highlights_body: A batch of performance PRs move color conversion, premultiply math, tag parsing and HarfBuzzSharp buffer handling into managed span-based code, cutting allocations and native round-trips. WASM builds move to Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new exnref exception handling model, and a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData is fixed.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances to m151, folding in the upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged throughout the preview cycle.
SKColor gains ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads alongside an optimized hex-parsing path.
Fixes a native resource leak when decoding a bounded subset of encoded image data.
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to correct a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: Color and premultiply math ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor -> SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, removing the `unsafe` modifier from GRContextOptions along the way.

bullets.lead: Allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper hot paths
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses a pooled UTF-8 encode, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse drop their per-call char[4] allocations, and SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans.

bullets.lead: WASM moves to Emscripten 5.0.6 with exnref exception handling
bullets.detail: New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries land for .NET 11, built with the new exnref exception-handling model, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch regressions early.

bullets.lead: Skia submodule drops the WASM build-flag redefinition
bullets.detail: Bumps the Skia submodule to remove an unnecessary SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition in the native build.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia submodule WASM build-flag cleanup and the Emscripten 5.0.6 static library work.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the m151 line by updating Skia to milestone m151.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Added the managed color/premultiply performance work, the HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper allocation-free paths, and span-based hex color parsing.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Cut the release candidate with the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries, the CPU raster regression fix, and the SKImage.FromEncodedData leak fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with a pooled UTF-8 encode and removes the per-call char[4] allocation from Tag.Parse.
